user_query: Evaluate the supplied amino-acid sequence and summarize likely protein identity/function, sequence-derived properties, domains, and any curated catalytic activity, cofactors, localization, and GO evidence. Clearly distinguish sequence-based inference from curated annotations.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

annotation.organism: Coprothermobacter proteolyticus (strain ATCC 35245 / DSM 5265 / OCM 4 / BT)
